semantic_changes: Native TcpStream creation reports qualified NONBLOCK/CLOEXEC flags.
Current UDP backend advertises zeroLengthDatagramSend=false and returns Unsupported without closing for empty sends.
Concurrent close waits for the admitted background owner; admitted UDP send failures remain non-retryable.
